item.content:encoded: 03:28 PM EDT, 09/14/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Financial stocks were lower in late Monday afternoon trading, with the NYSE Financial Index decreasing 0.7% and the State Street Financial Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLF) shedding 0.5%. The Philadelphia Housing Index rose 0.4%, and the State Street Real Estate Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLRE) eased 0.4%. Bitcoin (BTC-USD) was rising 3.1% to $79,166, and the yield for 10-year US Treasuries decreased 1.4 basis points to 4.961%. In corporate news, Aon (AON) has commenced a US investment-grade debt sale in seven tranches to help fund its planned $17 billion acquisition of USI Insurance Services from KKR (KKR), Bloomberg reported. Aon shares were up 2%.

item.content:encoded: 03:20 PM EDT, 09/14/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Consumer stocks were mixed late Monday afternoon, with the State Street Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLP) rising 1.4% and the State Street Consumer Discretionary Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLY) easing 0.1%. In corporate news, Kimberly-Clark (KMB) is preparing potential asset sales to address EU antitrust concerns over its proposed acquisition of Kenvue (KVUE), Reuters reported. The European Commission is expected to formally communicate its concerns to Kimberly-Clark this week following a preliminary review of the deal, the report added. Kimberly-Clark shares were up 2%.
